data.text:
Dymmmmn boy, $319 BILLION!

That is 1.1% of the entire U.S. GDP.

@fiverr  just dropped those numbers and they are a massive wake-up call for anyone STILL calling freelancing a "side hustle" :)

1.1% of the GDP isn’t a hobby, it’s a REAL economic force.

But the part that really hits? Businesses are flooding the market for independent talent because they're finally realizing a small, focused team of talents who actually care will out-deliver a bloated agencies and fulltimers EVERY SINGLE TIME.

And you can do it from anywhere now; Vegas, London, Philippines... does not matter. Also places like Thailand or Dubai are out-earning the old "tech hubs" because the "ladder" matters less than the work nowadays.

But here’s the disconnect that drives me crazy:

Freelancers are generating hundreds of billions... they're doing the heavy lifting for global companies... and most tools still treat them like they're just playing around part-time from their couch.

Clunky systems, multiple subscriptions, amateur software.

The world sees the value, but the tools? Still haven't caught up.

That’s exactly why we’re building https://t.co/4pNvoNh1yV

To back those who realized the corporate ladder was a dead end, and decided to bet on themselves instead... for those who had the balls to leave the 'safe' desk behind, and the ones who don't need a manager to tell them they’re doing a good job.

Let's get it!!
